link.title: Connect the gift to your Telegram
link.step1: Open fragment.com and log in with your Telegram account.
link.step2: Tap «Connect TON» and copy the link from the QR window.
link.step3: Paste the link below and tap «Send» (or send it to the bot).
link.step4: Fragment sends a confirmation to your Telegram — tap «Accept».
link.note: The link expires within minutes — send it right after copying.

connecting.text: Connecting… A Fragment request will arrive in your Telegram — tap «Accept».

active.title: Rental active
active.hint: If the gift isn't on your profile, tap «Show on profile again» (at most 3 times per hour).

final.expired: The rental has ended. Thank you!
final.failed: Something went wrong. The admin will contact you or refund the payment.

guide.title: How it works
guide.s1: Choose a gift and the rental period in the catalogue. Prices are shown in UZS.
guide.s2: Pay from your balance or transfer the exact amount to the card — the payment is confirmed automatically.
guide.s3: The admin confirms the payment and the gift is rented on Marketapp.
guide.s4: Tap «Connect Telegram» in the app and confirm in Telegram. After the first time, next gifts appear automatically.
guide.s5: The gift is on your profile. We'll remind you before it ends.
guide.safe: We never ask for your Telegram code, password or seed phrase.

bot.help: How it works 1. Pick a gift, username or number and the period in the app. 2. Pay from your balance or transfer the exact amount to the card — the payment is confirmed automatically. 3. The rental is made on Marketapp automatically. 4. Gift: press «Connect Telegram» — it shows on your profile. Number: get the login code in the app. ⭐ Stars and Premium — in the «Stars» section, from your balance. Commands: /orders — orders, /lang — language, /help — help
